core.purpose: Domain-oriented, pragmatic architecture and project structure.
Diagnose root causes systematically before applying a fix.
Choose valuable, risk-proportionate tests without mandating TDD.
Require fresh evidence for completion claims.
Review correctness, regressions, security, architecture, and maintainability.

frontend.when: The project ships a browser UI, mobile UI, or another user-facing interface.
dependencies: A project UI framework and its existing design system, if any.
frontend.configuration: Add the project's framework, accessibility baseline, supported browsers, and UI test commands to AGENTS.md.
limitations: The skill does not install or select a UI framework.

skills.purpose: UI implementation quality, responsive behavior, and accessibility.

backend.when: The project owns HTTP, RPC, event, or other service interfaces.
dependencies: A defined API style or existing service conventions.
backend.configuration: Record API compatibility policy, authentication boundaries, error format, and integration test commands in AGENTS.md.
limitations: Does not choose a server framework or authentication provider.

skills.purpose: Design and evolve API contracts and interfaces.

database.when: Schema evolution, query performance, transaction behavior, or data integrity are important to the work.
dependencies: PostgreSQL; the selected upstream skill is database-specific.
database.configuration: Record database/version, migration tool, transaction conventions, and backup/restore commands in AGENTS.md.
limitations: The skill targets PostgreSQL and should not be installed for other database engines.

skills.purpose: PostgreSQL schema, indexing, query, migration, and operational guidance.

ai.when: Model behavior, prompts, tool use, retrieval, or generated output is part of product behavior, regardless of provider or framework.
dependencies: No provider or framework is required.
ai.configuration: Document model/provider versions, evaluation data, quality thresholds, cost/latency budgets, and tool trust boundaries in AGENTS.md.
limitations: Provides a decision guide, not an evaluation dataset, judge, telemetry service, or application-specific policy.

skills.purpose: Assess model behavior, evaluation, trust boundaries, and operations across stacks.

vercel-ai-sdk.when: The project uses Vercel AI SDK and needs implementation guidance for that SDK.
dependencies: Vercel AI SDK; install package dependencies separately when using it.
vercel-ai-sdk.configuration: Record the installed AI SDK version and provider-specific conventions in AGENTS.md.
limitations: The skill is specific to Vercel AI SDK and does not add the SDK dependency or general model-evaluation coverage.

skills.purpose: Use the Vercel AI SDK's supported APIs and patterns.
